features.title: Text indexing with paragraph-aware chunking
features.user_visible_behavior: Documents are split into ~500-character chunks at paragraph boundaries. Chunks stored with metadata (character count, word count). Indexing status tracked per document and globally. User can index individual documents or the full library. Status bar shows real-time index state.
verification: Import a document and trigger indexing.
Verify chunks are created (~500 chars each, paragraph boundaries respected).
Verify chunk metadata includes character count and word count.
Verify status bar reflects indexing progress (idle → indexing → ready).
Verify full-library indexing processes all documents.
features.notes: IndexingService with PersistenceService. Chunks stored per-document as JSON. Index meta maps document IDs to chunk IDs.

features.title: Grounded Q&A with citations
features.user_visible_behavior: User asks natural language questions. System retrieves relevant chunks and returns answers with citations pointing to specific document chunks. Confidence score shown (0.85 with citations, 0.30 without). Full Q&A history persists across sessions.
verification: Import and index at least two documents.
Ask a question -- verify answer includes citation to a document chunk.
Verify confidence score is displayed.
Close and reopen the app -- verify Q&A history is preserved.
Ask a question with no relevant documents -- verify low-confidence response.
features.notes: QaService with keyword-based retrieval + mock patterns. Q&A history stored in qa-history.json. No LLM integration in this version.

features.title: Cross-session persistence and status bar
features.user_visible_behavior: All imported documents, index data, and Q&A history persist across application restarts. Document list loads automatically on startup. Status bar shows real-time index status, document count, and last activity timestamp. Data stored in knowledge-base-data/ in the user's application data directory.
verification: Import and index several documents.
Close and reopen the app -- verify all documents are listed.
Verify index data is preserved (no re-indexing needed for unchanged docs).
Verify Q&A history is preserved.
Verify status bar shows correct document count and index status.
features.notes: PersistenceService handles all I/O. Data stored in structured directory: documents-meta.json, content/<id>.txt, chunks/<id>.json, index/index-meta.json, qa-history.json.
